labels.source_quote: # DICER1 platform domain missense variants inhibit miRNA biogenesis and lead to tumor susceptibility

Abstract The endoribonuclease DICER1 plays an essential role in the microRNA (miRNA) biogenesis pathway, cleaving precursor miRNA (pre-miRNA) stem-loops to generate mature single-stranded miRNAs. Germline pathogenic variants (GPVs) in DICER1 result in DICER1 tumor predisposition syndrome (DTPS), a mainly childhood-onset tumor susceptibility disorder.
